title: AgentForge Merge Guard
problem: High-risk and AI-assisted pull requests need clear rules, evidence, and accountable reviewers.
impact: Built a GitHub PR governance service that applies deterministic policies and records evidence, reviews, and decisions.

title: Agentic Control Plane
problem: Long-running agent workflows need durable state and explicit human approvals.
impact: Built a TypeScript control plane with risk classification, background workers, and Postgres-backed state.

title: Apple Calendar MCP Server
problem: AI assistants need a safe, local way to work with Apple Calendar.
impact: Built a Swift/EventKit server and CLI for calendar search and editing through MCP.

title: Human Operating Model
problem: Autonomous agents need guidance for ambiguous tasks that require judgment and ownership.
impact: Authored a Codex skill for prioritization, validation, and transparent task delivery.

title: myIPSW
problem: Finding official Apple firmware (IPSW/OTA) downloads across devices was fragmented and manual.
impact: Built a site on the ipsw.me API surfacing iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and watchOS firmware downloads with a custom design.

title: PriceHikeSG
problem: Upcoming price increases across Singapore were hard to track in one place.
impact: Built a lightweight web app that aggregates and publishes updates on upcoming Singapore price hikes.

title: This Portfolio — Governed Static Delivery
problem: A personal portfolio needs the same content checks and secure delivery discipline as client work.
impact: Built a JSON-driven static site with automated content, security, performance, and accessibility checks.
